replies.author: Lieutenantpants
replies.body: Having to wait 15 seconds between forum posts is about the time it should take you to read the next topic and write your response. Unless you're replying twice to the same topic, and unless you're replying specifically to two different people, I don't see how this is a problem. It cuts down on forum spam, gives you the time to read over your post to see if you can improve it in quality or in grammar, and encourages users to condense all of their thoughts into a single post.
